mentions.name: Chromesthesia cymatics demo
mentions.description: This is a demo of chromesthesia, a form of synesthesia in which sounds trigger experiences of color. An initial visualization was replaced with a semi-physically accurate cymatics simulation — making sound visible as symmetric patterns that form and evolve on a vibrating surface — with artificial coloring based on chromesthesia. It supports both wave generation and microphone input, though it sometimes gets stuck and stops evolving as it should.
mentions.source_excerpt: Another project was a demo of chromesthesia, a form of synesthesia where sounds trigger experiences of color. I thought it was done and ready to release, but then I had a new idea. The visualization while cool, was kind of boring. I decided to replace it with an attempt at a semi-physically accurate cymatics simulation with artificial coloring based on chromesthesia.
